textwithimage.text:
Intel Atom® x6000 Series, Pentium® and Celeron® Processors of 6th Generation ("Elkhart Lake")

The TQMxE40S is a versatile SMARC 2.1 module featuring Intel Atom® x6000 Series, Pentium®, and Celeron® processors from the 6th generation, codenamed "Elkhart Lake." This compact module packs dual/quad-core computing power with clock speeds of up to 3.0 GHz, making it suitable for a wide range of industrial applications. It offers up to 16 GB of LPDDR4x memory with inband ECC support and comes with dual Gbit Ethernet interfaces for robust network connectivity.

In terms of expansion, the TQMxE40S offers four PCIe lanes (Gen3) and a variety of USB ports, including two high-speed USB 3.1 Gen2 ports. The module supports triple display output with two DP++ (4K) interfaces and eDP (4K)/LVDS (Dual Channel) support. It also includes up to 256 GB of soldered eMMC Flash memory.

The module is designed with industrial applications in mind, boasting an extended temperature range from -40°C to +85°C. It comes in a compact SMARC form factor measuring 82 mm x 50 mm, making it suitable for space-constrained environments. The integrated board controller supports features like thermal management and a multi-stage watchdog for added reliability.

With impressive graphics and video processing capabilities, as well as support for virtualization and real-time applications, the TQMxE40S is an ideal choice for industries such as industrial automation, medical technology, aviation, and more. Its combination of performance, compactness, and extended temperature support makes it a versatile solution for various embedded computing needs.

text.text:
Features

  • Enhanced Computing Power: Intel Atom® x6000 Series processors, offering dual/quad-core computing capabilities with clock speeds of up to 3.0 GHz.

  • Robust Memory and Storage: 16 GB of LPDDR4x memory and up to 256 GB of soldered eMMC Flash memory

  • Versatile Display Options: Triple display output, including 4K resolution, with two DP++ interfaces and eDP/LVDS support

  • Industrial-Grade Reliability: Designed for industrial use, it operates reliably within an extended temperature range of -40°C to +85°C, 

  • Expansion and Connectivity: Multiple USB ports, four PCIe lanes (Gen3), dual Gbit Ethernet interfaces, and support s a versatile connectivity options for diverse applications.
